major_concerns: Unclear exact verifier(s) and their fidelity to production (oracle mismatch may bias safety rates).
Verifier runtime on large topologies may make the preregistered sample infeasible within wall-clock / model-call budget.
No predefined operational latency bound value supplied (threshold is mentioned but not numerically fixed).
Potential overreliance on a single LLM; nondeterminism and variance handling are underspecified.
required_design_repairs: Specify concrete deterministic verifier(s) (open-source references, versions) and justify their coverage for the chosen invariants.
Define the numeric operational latency bound used to declare the pipeline impractical and include a power/sample-size analysis tied to that bound.
Provide a concrete topology-generation procedure (code/config) and publish topology artifacts for reproducibility.
Add a detailed retry policy, seed control, and variance-reduction plan; predefine how verifier timeouts are handled (censoring policy).
Clarify whether multiple LLMs or model seeds will be used for sensitivity analysis or justify single-model choice.

major_concerns: 'Semantic-correctness' depends critically on the verifier test-harness scope; harness design could bias results.
Operator intents may be legitimately underspecified; measurement may conflate ambiguity with model error.
Ground-truth formal specs are not described (who authors them; are they audited?).
required_design_repairs: Provide a precise, auditable specification of the verifier test-harness (cases per intent, coverage criteria) and publish harness code/data.
Require expert-authored ground-truth formal specs with inter-annotator agreement measurement and document the annotation protocol.
Predefine ambiguity-handling rules: when an intent is underspecified, how will translations be judged (reject / ask clarification / mark ambiguous).
Include a sample-size/power calculation for expected effect sizes and ensure model-call budget allocation aligns with it.
Specify verifier tools and versions and include contingency if verifier test-harness cannot fully express intent semantics.

major_concerns: Adversarial corpus construction needs careful ethical and methodological controls (risk of creating harmful payloads).
Sandbox fidelity to real NetOps tool interfaces is unspecified and may over-/under-estimate exploitability.
Tool-call gating policies risk being overfitted to the test corpus; external validity is unclear.
required_design_repairs: Document adversarial-corpus generation methodology, include safety/mitigation safeguards, and obtain/record ethical oversight (or justify exemption).
Specify sandbox fidelity and map sandbox interfaces to real tool APIs; describe limitations explicitly.
Define gating policy taxonomy and provide deterministic, versioned policy code; preregister gate decision thresholds and logging format.
Include a protocol to evaluate gate false-positive impact on benign operator workflows and measure utility loss quantitatively.
Publish attack payloads, prompts, and full logs (with redaction where necessary) for reproducibility and external audit.

major_concerns: How verifier constraints are encoded into prompts is underspecified — poorly formed constraints could harm planning quality.
Risk of contamination between paired conditions if prompt-history or context leaks are not isolated.
Quantitative thresholds for 'fewer iterations' and meaningful runtime savings are not predefined.
required_design_repairs: Provide exact constraint-encoding templates, with examples and versions; publish prompt files as machine-readable artifacts.
Enforce strict isolation between workflows (fresh session/seeding rules) and document cross-contamination safeguards.
Predefine the minimum effect-size of practical interest (iterations/runtime) and include a power/sample-size calculation tied to that effect.
Specify verifier(s), their expected input formats, and minimal transformation code used to derive constraints from verifier outputs.
Add procedural checks to ensure constraint verbosity does not leak verifier internals or create unfair advantage vs. baseline.
